title: JLab Go Talk USB Gaming Streaming Microphone (with code JLABWOOT)

writeup: JLab's GO Talk is a plug-and-play USB-C condenser mic that records at 96kHz/24-bit and switches between cardioid and omnidirectional pickup, with a quick mute and a 3.5mm monitoring jack. Woot has it for $19.99, and code JLABWOOT takes another $5 off (new customers save $10) through Nov 6, versus $28.99 plus shipping at Walmart and $49 at Target.
